bypass_options.notes: Egypt: Ain Sukhna (Red Sea) to Sidi Kerir (Mediterranean), the standard overland bypass when the Canal itself is blocked or congested. Near-zero extra transit time. Estimate.

For traffic the SUMED pipeline can't absorb (its throughput is well below Suez's ~9M bpd total oil flow). Unlimited capacity but adds ~8-10 days for Asia/Gulf-to-Europe routes. Estimate (2021 Ever Given blockage precedent).

explanation: 2,500,000 bpd depends on suez. Pipeline/alternate-strait bypasses (SUMED Pipeline) can absorb all of it with little to no added transit time.
